A parity proof resolves a fixed list of addresses (cc, cc.1, a bus verb, an unknown word, a case-folded token) through both and compares target and exit code. Depends on 380d524e6e9c.

answers.what: After its floor checks, bin/cairn on Linux execs the venv python on bin/cairn.py (outline 5.4.3.8), so one dispatcher serves both platforms.

bullets.text: Measured: 2026-11-20 read of bin/cairn on akiendell: 479 lines, 295 of code; lines 94-217 are the bash floor (venv, db, wiring, instance), lines 218-313 the help, lines 314-479 the dispatch (token fold, instance split, device and bus resolution, exec). bin/proofs holds 34 proofs, 21 of which drive the launcher. This box cannot run a Linux read of them, so riding Linux on slice 1 (ticket 380d524e6e9c) is not cheap from here: it re-reads 21 proofs on a platform I do not hold. Owed by outline 5.4.3.8; the floor stays bash (5.4.3.8.1).
